description: This file defines the Java interface `CenterReadPlatformService` which declares methods for reading and retrieving data related to centers within the portfolio group module of the Fineract system. It includes method signatures for retrieving templates, specific center data, associated groups, and centers by meeting date.

classes.name: CenterReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining read operations for center entities within the group module of the Fineract system.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template (likely for creating or editing) for a center, given an office ID and a flag indicating staff in selected office only.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves data for a single center identified by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllForDropdown
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of center data suitable for populating a dropdown list for a specific office.

methods.name: retrievePagedAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of center data based on search and pagination parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of center data based on search parameters without pagination.

methods.name: retrieveCenterGroupTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves group template data associated with a specific center.

methods.name: retrieveAssociatedGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all groups associated with a specified center.

methods.name: retrieveCenterWithClosureReasons
methods.description: Retrieves center data along with possible closure reasons.

methods.name: retriveAllCentersByMeetingDate
methods.description: Retrieves all centers for an office that have a meeting scheduled on a specific date, optionally filtered by staff ID.
